result.reasoning:
REFUTED. The reporter's arithmetic replicates, but the two pieces of it that would actually move a published number or a decision both fail, and the part that survives points the same way as the headline.

1) NO PUBLISHED NUMBER MOVES. +1.18 / 87% / 93% reproduce exactly from runs/F1*/sweep_s2.json and are bit-identical in sweep_s3.json. The reporter concedes this.

2) "最好的那条底座(F111)掉 2.18" IS A DIRECTION-MISMATCH ARTIFACT OF THE VARIANT ID, NOT A PROPERTY OF THE ACTION. /Users/wxy/Desktop/Partura/scripts/sweep.py:112-117 builds `seg_lowliq_p = cs_first_low40(X, LIQ)` and `seg_lowliq_m = cs_first_low40(neg(X), LIQ)`, and score() locks sign=+1 for any `cs_(first|last)_(low|high)\d+` root. 14 of 15 bases have sign=-1, so `_m` carries their own direction; F111 is the ONLY sign=+1 base, so for F111 `_m` is the REVERSED direction — not "按因子自己的方向选" as the row label says. F111's direction-matched cell is `seg_lowliq_p`: +2.19 vs base +2.15 → d = +0.04, not -2.18. Direction-matched: all 15 → med +1.18 (unchanged), mean +1.13→+1.28, down 7%→0%, both 93%→100%; base>=1 → med +0.41 (unchanged), mean +0.09→+0.53, down 20%→0%, values +1.30/+0.41/+0.76/+0.15/+0.04. So the reporter's "mean +0.09" — the number that makes the action look inert on good bases — is produced entirely by one mislabeled cell (swing 0.44, outside the ±0.3 band). The surviving conditional median +0.41 is in the SAME direction as the headline and above the noise band.

3) "seg_hiliq_p 不能与 seg_lowliq_m 互相印证" RESTS ON A MISREADING OF THE s2 SIGN. In s2 `sign_locked` did not exist yet (None in sweep_s2.json, True in sweep_s3.json), so the rank IC flipped every cs_first_high40 variant: seg_hiliq_p and seg_hiliq_m were scored at sign = -1 for all 15 factors. I verified synthetically that `-cs_first_high40(X, LIQ)` puts 0% of the long book in the high-40%-LIQ names and 66% in the low-40%, picking LOW X. So seg_hiliq_p as measured = "exclude the top-40% Amt, pick by the factor's own direction" — exactly the published label 「把成交额最高四成排到最后」, and the SAME two coordinates as seg_lowliq_m (low-liquidity tilt + own direction), implemented by exclusion rather than inclusion. The real s2 2x2 is: own direction → seg_lowliq_m +1.18 (include) / seg_hiliq_p +1.01 (exclude); reversed → seg_lowliq_p -0.23 (include) / seg_hiliq_m -1.04 (exclude). Two independent implementations agree on both rows, which is corroboration, not a confound. The reporter's labels 「同向的 seg_hiliq_m」/「反向的 seg_lowliq_p」 are inverted.

4) THE PROPOSED "纯分段配置项" IS ALREADY MEASURED AND PUBLISHED, from the anatomy rather than the paired statistic: lowest-Amt quintile's own equal-weight excess +15.1%/yr, highest -17.8%/yr (B01_batch_summary.md:169, :353); the allocation/selection dot product 「原式 +5.5 个点来自跨成交额桶的倾斜(占 +8.9% 的六成),k_known 是 +14.7 个点(占 +15.4% 的 95%)」 (:231); 「钱全在「段倾斜」不在段内选股 … 段内净超额 = -4.7/-2.9/-0.0/+4.2/+1.2」 (:416); 「多头腿的净超额 100% 来自流动性倾斜,控住流动性后它在每个桶里都亏钱」 (:543). E4 (B01_reverse_guidance.md:37, guidance/B01.yaml:77-78) is the standing instruction to report allocation separately from within-segment selection. A constant-panel item would change no reported number.

5) CONDITIONING ON base>=1 STRENGTHENS R2. The direct test of "the reward pays for liquidity tilt" is what happens when the tilt is removed, and on exactly the reporter's conditioning set it gets worse: bk_liq med -0.83 (vs -0.47 unconditional), res_liq -0.93 (vs -0.35), bk_known -1.04 (vs -0.57), res_known -1.05 (vs -0.50). §3.1's own note already draws this inference. The prescription is unchanged under the reporter's re-cut.

6) THE VARIANCE COMPRESSION IS CONCLUSION 1'S MECHANISM, NOT A COUNTEREXAMPLE. Regressing d on base sharpe: slope -0.88, intercept +1.67, i.e. variant sharpe ~= 1.67 + 0.12*base; the wrapper imposes its own level (+1.84 med, sd 0.64) and washes out the factor (base sd 1.11). "Any expression wearing the low-liquidity segmentation is handed ~+1.8 against a median base of +0.70" is a STRONGER form of "the reward is paying for liquidity tilt" than the increment statistic, and is precisely why the GP head fills with the Amt family. Likewise "14/15 below the known family's +2.22" confirms that what they capture is the known liquidity money — which is what conclusion 1 asserts and headline 4 repeats. Conclusion 1 never claims the segment selection beats the known pool.

RESIDUAL (below the bar): the words 「不管套在哪条因子上」 overstate the INCREMENT (what is invariant is the level ~+1.84, not the gain), and the §3.1 F111 cell is mislabeled because the id is pinned to `_m`. Both are wording/presentation; no number and no decision moves.

result.corrected_fix:
Do NOT adopt the reporter's fix. Conditioning headline 1 and B01.yaml's R2 on "底座夏普 >= 1" conditions on the comparison baseline itself, throws away 10 of 15 cases, and leaves the median unchanged at +0.41 anyway — it would weaken a correct statement while changing no number. Replacing the seg_hiliq_p cross-read with seg_hiliq_m is also wrong: as scored in s2, seg_hiliq_p IS the direction- and segment-matched partner of seg_lowliq_m (sign=-1 flips cs_first_high40 into a high-liquidity exclusion screen), while seg_hiliq_m is the reversed-direction cell.

Two cheap, strictly-presentational corrections are worth making instead, neither of which changes a number:

(a) Report the INVARIANT LEVEL alongside the increment, since the level is what the reward actually hands out. In scripts/guidance_report.py:64-65, replace 「不管套在哪条因子上都把纯多头夏普抬高 +1.18」 with something like: 「这一个动作把纯多头夏普钉在 +1.84 附近(中位 +1.84、标准差 0.64,底座中位 +0.70、标准差 1.11;d 对底座的回归斜率 -0.88、截距 +1.67),套在 15 条因子上的增量中位 +1.18(87% 明显变好、93% 两段都升)—— 奖励给任何带低流动性分段的写法发 ~+1.8 分,而这一段的等权超额本身就是 +15.1%/年。」 The +15.1%/yr factor-free segment allocation number already exists (B01_batch_summary.md:169/:231/:353/:416/:543), so this is a citation, not a new experiment. Mirror the same sentence into guidance/B01.yaml R2_within_liquidity_bucket.why.

(b) Fix the one mislabeled cell. The §3.1 row and scripts/motif_stats.py pin the id to `seg_lowliq_m` for every factor, but `_m` only carries the base's own direction when the base's sign is -1. Pick the id per factor (`_m` when v_base.sign < 0, `_p` when > 0) so the row matches its own label 「按因子自己的方向选」. This leaves the published median at +1.18 and improves the rest (mean +1.13 → +1.28, 明显变差 7% → 0%, 两段都升 93% → 100%); it also removes the spurious F111 -2.18 cell. Apply the same per-factor direction matching to the seg_* / scr_* family generally.

Separately, and NOT part of this defect, two real bugs surfaced while checking it and should be filed on their own: (i) sweep_s2.json predates the sign lock, so the published §3.1 rows for seg_hiliq_p / seg_hiliq_m / seg_new_p describe sign-flipped operators — the labels happen to be right for s2 but the same ids mean the opposite thing in s3 (seg_hiliq_p +1.01 → -3.18, seg_new_p +0.41 → -4.47); any future comparison of §3.1 against s3 numbers will read backwards unless the table states its tag and the sign-lock status. (ii) U5's weight of 1.5 on the cs_first_* / cs_last_* family cites this same +1.18, which is ~pure segment allocation; its defensible evidence is the known_xfrozen 3.15 vs 2.22 screen, not the liquidity segmentation that R2 exists to stop paying for.
